[b]The War by the ally[/b]
It had only been two hours since the three men had met in the garden; however, fresh intelligence received by the Yzakastanian armed forces security branch showed a startling undertaking by Wuloosya.
Were we not just in their capital? Enquired Cahit, his face turned into a deep frown, the lights of the conference room falling upon his face like some sort of Renaissance painting.
Yes, replied the shah bluntly, However, it seems our allies have undertaken a war against a state to the north of them, Rosenmarkke, is the name of that state, he continued quietly.
This bears grave questions on our relations with Wuloosya, according to the intelligence, the war was sparked by minor radio interference, said Edis.
Minor. Radio. Interference? asked Cahit, his jowls beginning to tremble.
Please, remain calm, this is the time for deliberation, intoned the Shah with grave solemnity.
It is absurd, that we would continue to support such a government, said Edis with a shake of his head, Yet we cannot afford offending them, he continued, What a fix we have put ourselves in! 
Did Rosenmarkke launch anything at them? Asked Cahit in trembling disbelief.
No, it was just radio interference, replied the shah.
Can we do anything? I mean, what is the Rosenmarkket position? asked Cahit.
We are trying to get into the details, but our intel scope is limited, I meanwe have never really had to look into Elseyran affairs, said the Shah with a shake of his head.
Will it benefit us to support Wuloosya? asked Cahit.
No, replied the shah firmly, There is no need, I believe that if the Wuloosyan government has determined that war against another sovereign state is necessary, and without provocation, I believe that the grave they dig is the grave they shall lay in, should they fail their objectives, he said, I do not desire instability here,
Cahit nodded thoughtfully, I do worry about future relations though, yknow, when all this hubbub is done, he chortled, patting his belly.
We will get to it when we get to it, replied Edis, Anything else? 
The shah nodded a silent no.
A few hours later, the office of the shah released a simple statement, cold and empty of the friendly emotions that had been shared during the visit to Wuloosya.
[i]The government of Yzakastan watches the recent developments with Wuloosya and calls for reasonable de-escalation moves to be taken.[/i]
